390 Before and After

Banchi · 390 × 844 · light and dark

Every change you would see on a phone

Two pull requests are open and neither is merged. Everything below is the real app at iPhone width over the demo store — “on main” is what you have now, “with both PRs” is what merging would give you. Nothing here is a drawing.

24%of the screen taken by the pricing ship bar was 51%
40pxthe checkbox a thumb presses was 19.5px
1brand in the shell, at every width was 3
0controls under the floor at 390 was 25

80 changes in the diff, 42 of them visible at 390. The 30 below are every one you could point at. The other 38 are invisible on purpose and stay off this page: a literal replaced by the token that already resolved to it, an arm widened so a tablet gets a rule a phone already had, a transparent hit-pad that moves nothing on screen, or a state the demo store cannot produce — a toast needs a write, code cards need code cards.

before = origin/main @ c85315b · after = both PRs merged in order · demo store: 4 boxes, 122 cards, 2 runs, 9 review entries, 7 orders

Show

PR #206D116 · logo.md §19

The shell stops speaking two brands

Above 1023px the product drew 番地 over BANCHI. Below 768 it drew a tile, a wordmark and a tagline — three brand objects in one shell, and on dark the tile all but vanished into the bar. The lockup cannot go in a 52px bar; its floor is a 102 × 75 block. So the bar draws what the collapsed rail draws, and the drawer draws what the open sidebar draws.

PR #211D117

The thumb floor moves into the kit

CLAUDE.md has published a 40px floor for this width since the rebuild, and nothing read it — cursor.spec.ts harvests its routes from a sidebar that is display:none below 768, so it cannot run here even in principle. Twenty-five controls were under the floor. The fix is in the kit where it belongs, and a phone-width spec now reads it.
